# Test Fixtures

This directory contains small local fixtures for Interleaf Reader smoke testing.

## `interleaf_smoke.epub`

`interleaf_smoke.epub` is generated by:

```powershell
python scripts\generate_smoke_epub.py
```

If plain `python` resolves incorrectly, use the bundled runtime:

```powershell
C:\Users\Susie\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe scripts\generate_smoke_epub.py
```

The generated EPUB is copyright-safe, self-authored fixture text. It is not copied from any novel, fanfiction, lyrics, dictionary, or external source.

The fixture intentionally includes terms from the current seed vocabulary so browser smoke tests can exercise:

- EPUB import and diagnostics
- chapter navigation
- English Study Mode rendering
- Vocabulary Preview matches
- underlined vocabulary bubble behavior
- Local Library save/restore/forget
- Chinese and Mixed Mode placeholders

Fixture terms include `anxious`, `reluctant`, `glance`, `mutter`, `tension`, `figure out`, `bring up`, and `back off`.
